description: Work toward a goal on one branch with a team of workers: cut the goal's branch, give each ready task a worker on a child branch, merge each finished child up once its check passes, and hand the owner one command to land the goal's branch. Also lists and writes local task files. Use for "run the loop", "start the team", "dispatch workers", "fold", "land it".
